people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
translations.bsb: And though they found no ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.
translations.kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
translations.asv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet asked they of Pilate that he should be slain.
